properties.decision:
@ajs, 2026-10-05: "we had brainstormed about creating a sligara7.github.io/reflow2 page (now would flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2 I'd imagine) ... I think the new github.io page should have the instructions as you laid them out. It should have the basic setup (which is what we use here); it should have the setup instructions for how I use it at work; and it should have the instructions for how Alex uses it at his work. I think that is the minimum we can start with for our page. We can add to it later, but that's how I'd like to start. I like the black background and white text and green buttons like we used on flo2.io." He also asked that the names and details specific to any one person or workplace be removed.

Asked whether that reopens dec:idea-what-is-on-reflow2s-public-page (accepted 2026-08-14, reaffirmed 2026-09-28: the public page carries ONLY renderings generated from reflow2's own design), he chose, the same day: "Setup hand-written (Recommended)".

WHAT IS SETTLED:
- The site's SETUP pages are written by hand. They are addressed to someone who does not have reflow2 yet, which COORD.md's rule puts in a document ("a document holds what is addressed to someone without the tool; the graph holds what the tool can compute").
- Any page that says what reflow2 IS, or how its design works, stays generated from the design, as the 2026-08-14 decision requires. The setup page links to the README for that and says nothing about it itself.
- The first content is three setup paths: on your own computer (an MCP agent), VS Code where an organisation blocks third-party MCP (the terminal route), and a server for a team (the container image). No person or workplace is named.
- Laid out like flo2.io, in its dark palette: black background, light text, green buttons.
- The address is flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2, since the repository moved to the flo2-connector organisation on 2026-10-03.

CHOSEN BY THE IMPLEMENTER, AS THE DEFAULT THE REQUIREMENT ITSELF POINTED TO (the owner can override): Pages is published by an Actions deploy of site/ (.github/workflows/pages.yml), not from the root, /docs or a gh-pages branch, because the root is a Rust workspace. Version numbers and image digests are left off the page and linked to the latest release instead, so the page is not wrong after the next cut.

NOT IN THIS STEP, AND STILL INTENT under req:reflow2-has-a-public-page-anyone-can-read: the minimal README, and moving the documentation out of docs/ into generated pages. The repository clean-up the owner mentioned in the same message is not part of this step either.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-05 — reflow2's site starts with hand-written setup pages (on your own computer, VS Code where MCP is blocked, a server for a team); any page about what reflow2 is or how its design works stays generated from the design
properties.rationale: The setup steps are the content a newcomer needs first, and they are the one kind of page the repository's own rule says belongs in a document rather than in the design. Generating them from the graph would mean writing install commands into the design only to render them back out, a larger build for no truth gained. The carve-out is kept narrow, so the reason for the 2026-08-14 decision (a page claiming to come from the graph is falsified by one hand-written fact) still holds for every page that describes the design.
